units.solutions: Opening: the quick answer after 'then' can support playfulness; the family question and guardian's dismissal support reassurance; 'I' supports personally taking the family role. None proves a promise covering every later event. The smile is supported by STORY_V3_5 §06 completion summary, line245, while the detailed scene B uses a different guardian reply; current Dokkaebi's line is from LEVEL_STORY's authored learning dialogue. Guided: evaluative 이라고 questions whether the incomplete notice merits the name; naming 이라고 reports a label. 이라고는 limits the reply to 'checking', below expected time/place information. 깨나 can admire a useful organised collection or mock an unusable pile; 을랑 assigns address checking to the speaker while the listener checks time; 이라면 singles out all-nighters for strong aversion, not a permission condition. Script: twenty files but one usable date conflicts with 'very thorough', supporting irony, while original voice and actual anger remain unknown. Keep the preceding line in the interpretation. Small talk: 'Interesting' can express genuine interest or surprise; the supplied clarification answers both fit. Independent: preceding readability praise supports recognition of effort; following request to halve preparation time supports concern about workload. Both coexist; no recording establishes sarcasm. Ask which part of table preparation should be shortened first. Opening: a child's offer in a particular relationship does not impose a universal obligation on everyone close to someone. Guided 15-year-old: may apply despite living elsewhere and may watch hand-tool demonstration; cannot join power-tool practice because under sixteen. Reading safety information is not completion of training or slot confirmation. Reject draft's all-applicants and automatic-slot claims; name Sujin for guidance and Christian for bookings. Form practice: isolate 'application guarantees a slot' as unsupported; sixteen is necessary, not sufficient; accept applications subject to briefing/confirmed turn; residence scope applies only to application; already-circulated error requires direct correction to recipients; original sender is responsible; 보건대 introduces a judgement rather than supplying missing evidence; nominal task labels retain owners. Script answers: residence-unrestricted application; instructor confirms practice order after briefing; Christian checks recipient list for correction, a new assigned task distinct from bookings in the first table. Small talk: same application criteria, briefing checked separately; asking staff is also acceptable. Independent: membership irrelevant to application, but staff clearance required for original; eighteen informed, five cleared, actual consultations unreported. Minho checks access, Lena revises guidance. Editorial follow-up: '안내를 받으면 원본을 볼 수 있다는 문장을 바로잡아야 해요. 이미 보낸 마당에 같은 수신자에게 정정을 보내요. 우리가 보낸 안내이니만큼 직접 알려야 해요. 담당자의 확인을 받은 사람이라야 원본을 볼 수 있어요.' Check another time for those unable to attend at2pm, without promising availability. Transfer constructed notice: members and nonmembers may request a room; confirmed booking, not enquiry alone, permits use; coordinator checks availability. Receptive 건대 and productive293–298/300 align with allocation. E06 gate and fictional modern rules remain separate.

Materials: common event is preparation completed at18:00, expected colleague not yet arrived. A's permission to rest supports relief; B's absent colleague supports regret about finishing early, not evidence of the colleague's anger. Guided open door does not establish someone outside; lack of audible footsteps is observation, expected visit is interpretation. Letter survives but expression unrecorded: '편지는 남았지만 그때 표정은 알 수 없어요' is allowed without literary production. Meetings1/2/4 missed reminder,3 sent: frequent within these four, not always. Twelve metres and '길디긴' distinguish measurement and experience. Laughter is observed, mockery is critic's inferred intent, 'utterly rude' is intense evaluation. New productions: '중복 제목 두 개를 지워 치우고 후련해했어요'; '최근 다섯 번에는 첨부를 빠뜨리기 일쑤였지만 한 번은 붙였어요'; '안내를 보내 버린 뒤 날짜 오류를 알아 아쉬웠어요'; no reader reaction invented. Script:18:00 completion shared, following sentences supply relief/regret, colleague's response unrecorded. Small talk allows mixed feelings and asks evidence. Independent: reply sent14:00, narrator feels relief, whether recipient read/replied unknown; English key currently changes reading to receipt. Transfer three sentences: closed window and two empty chairs; capture time and reason no person is present unknown; proposed title is creative attribution, not proof anyone failed to return. Productive303/304/308 and receptive301/302/305–307 correctly separated; E06 gated reinterpretation adds no later history.

Estate: Dokkaebi could not leave the grounds, so his waiting cannot create a universal voluntarily chosen duty. Modern facts: presentation tomorrow, raw figures absent; own rework possible, colleagues' overtime unapproved; verified-only presentation possible but scope/delay not agreed. Receptive: ten rewrites hypothetical, not counted fact; shorter text accepted over unsourced assertions; urgency does not justify unchecked quotation; recurring arrival of new versions limited to recorded period. Fresh three reviews: revised version arrived each time this week, with no basis to infer every comparison was actually interrupted. Ordinary 더라도 does not imply all-night work. New productive sentences: '내 원고를 다시 쓰는 한이 있어도 오류를 바로잡겠어요'; '쉽게 쓴다고 줄이다가 날짜를 빠뜨렸어요'; '비율을 비교하자면 분모부터 맞춰야 해요'; '빼자니 반론이 빠지고 두자니 한 쪽을 넘으니 별첨을 제안해요'; '물어보려도 담당자 연락처를 몰라요'; '근거 없는 그래프를 낼 바에 출처를 적은 글로 설명할게요'; '답이 늦더라도 추측을 사실처럼 쓰지 않겠어요'. Script: Maya commits only her own time; no agreement for collective overtime; verified-only scope remains a proposal for organiser. Small talk accepts resolve while negotiating time; state own capacity. Independent two sentences: speaker proposes accepting delay rather than using unverified figures; no schedule change has been agreed. Existing one-sentence key omits the central figures principle. Transfer: size variety is aim; three spaces cannot display all five at once; all-small selection weakens aim; propose rotation and ask all participants to agree, without unilateral removal. Productive311/313–316/318/319 and receptive309/310/312/317 align.

Opening separates a quotation of the already revealed family promise from a present instruction or new player duty. Roleplay: Hyuna originally instructed B to send summary file first; absent A now asks B what was said; B is recipient and reporter; actual sending unreported. Receptive models: 자면2 makes Lena's future suggestion a condition, not an actual proposal; 보내라던가 recalls reported instruction; final 던 asks familiar listener's experience rather than modifying a noun; 으래서야 challenges unreasonable ten-page/five-minute demand; quoted 이라고 reports Sujin's label whereas evaluative 이라고 criticises, without officially changing draft status. Productive experience question: '안내문을 읽어 보니 입구 위치가 분명하던가?' then polite '안내문을 읽으셨을 때 입구 위치가 분명했나요?' Role-limited hage use is explicit. New quotation task: Maya said she will check tomorrow afternoon, so status remains planned, not completed. Script: Hyuna requested summary first; photos are Lena's unapproved addition; summary not yet sent and Lena plans checking before sending. Small talk acknowledges misattributed opinion and labels own view. Independent: A conditionally asks to be told if Lena proposes joint review; no proposal yet. Transfer three sentences: A asks B to confirm date in prior return instruction; B heard no date, so tomorrow's visit unconfirmed; wording establishes neither age nor kinship, and no later act can be added. Assigned325/327–329 receptive,326 productive and330 quotative reuse are implemented. E06 gate and optional-next-unit boundary are clear.

Fewer gaps next edition remains expected, editing not begun. Historical 捨學何以哉 is rhetorical emphasis on continued learning, supported by preceding wish to preserve ancestors' work; modern paraphrase '선조의 뜻을 이어 가려면 배움을 놓을 수 없습니다'. Verified archive example19 and1808 through official indexed page; direct fetch timed out. B: solitary 던가 searches own memory; three copies do not become three independent sources; final 라 states, not commands; interrupting-friend rebuke becomes '제 말을 끝까지 듣고 말씀해 주실 수 있을까요?' for newly met colleague. Friday self-question has no external addressee and no confirmed weekday. C: extra-page example conditional; no-time example present reason. NIKL official entry confirms connective condition versus sentence-final reason. D:343 states waiting plan,347 notices shortening;346 merely draws attention and reports no completed correction; age unknown. New polite version '이 줄을 보세요. 이름이 빠졌네요.' E:349 sign report is not map confirmation; 앉- takes 으오, 오- takes 오;351 requests sitting not yet done,352 observes entry underway; no supplied sarcasm for353. 들어오구려 is invitation A, modern 들어오세요. F: reaction versus editorial policy do not prove universal reader comprehension; preserve third-person subject honour with '교수님이 읽으세요'; current reading does not establish finishing. Script: editing not begun, source is prediction, literary confidence may be described separately from results. Small talk permits choosing one bookmark. Independent three sentences: tomorrow's reply expected; where it was heard unclear; today's entry ends here; no reply received established. Transfer two audience sentences plus editor sentence: image and wording are modern creation; suggest an absence difficult to forget without reporting actual disappearance; rhetorical 으리오 stresses difficulty, not requests names or alternatives. English task currently changes photograph of box into box itself. E06 gated scene; all optional receptive work excluded from mandatory completion/ending gates.

findings.location: 집필 메모 'STORY_V3_5 본편 B' and '회상의 세 대사와 도깨비의 현재 첫 대사는 기존 출처'
findings.problem: The shortened guardian reply and smile are supported by STORY_V3_5 §06 completion summary, line245, not by the detailed scene B alone. The current Dokkaebi line comes from LEVEL_STORY's authored learning dialogue. The general source note makes these distinct kinds of provenance unnecessarily hard to verify.
findings.proposal: Replace the provenance note with '집필 메모. LEVEL_STORY_100 C2.1-01의 현재 도깨비 학습용 대사, STORY_V3_5 §06 안채 완공 요약(회상의 세 대사·미소), 본편 장면 B(가족 기억 공개 맥락), 원배정 320–324 수용. 나머지는 학습용 추가 집필. 독립 검토 대기.' If editorial policy standardises the guardian reply to scene B, update all three language cells together; the present shortened quotation itself also has a canonical source.

findings.location: 어휘 척도 EN 'Barely one page' / 'too little'
findings.problem: The Korean says the speaker regards one page as a small amount; the English adds insufficiency ('too little') and 'barely' can suggest not quite a whole page.
findings.proposal: EN: '“Only one page” shows that the speaker regards one page as a small amount.'

findings.location: 독립 자료 EN 'I sent it at last'; 답 EN 'receipt or reply unknown'
findings.problem: The source only states completed sending and subsequent relief; 'at last' adds a delayed or long-awaited sending. More decisively, the answer changes whether the recipient read the reply into whether it arrived. Reading and delivery are different evidence states in an exercise about not adding facts.
findings.proposal: Independent EN: 'Recollection: “I sent the reply. Afterwards, waiting felt lighter.” Record: sent at 14:00 only. Separate completion, evaluation and unknown recipient reaction.' Key EN: 'Sent at 14:00; the speaker feels relief; whether the recipient read it or replied is unknown.'

findings.location: 전이 candidate title 'Someone never returned'; model 'Time and absence are unexplained'
findings.problem: 'Never' strengthens the simple past 돌아오지 않았다, and 'absence is unexplained' is less exact than the specified unknown reason for no people in the photo.
findings.proposal: Use 'Someone did not return' for both occurrences of the creative title. Replace model's second EN sentence with 'When the photo was taken and why no one is there are unknown.'

findings.location: 수용 새 자료 answer EN 'Each of this week's three comparisons was interrupted by a new version'
findings.problem: The fresh facts and Korean answer say a new revision arrived each time. They do not state each comparison was interrupted. The English turns a plausible practical consequence into a reported event in a lesson explicitly bounding inferences.
findings.proposal: EN answer: 'At each of this week’s three comparisons, a new revised version arrived.'

findings.location: 독립 자료·과제 two-sentence requirement versus one-sentence answer '지연 감수 제안이며 실제 지연 결정은 아니다'
findings.problem: The model gives only one sentence despite explicitly requiring two, and drops the speaker's substantive principle against using unchecked figures. It answers status but not the whole meaning.
findings.proposal: KO: '확인하지 않은 수치를 쓰느니 발표가 늦어져도 괜찮다는 제안입니다. 다만 일정 변경에 합의한 것은 아닙니다.' EN: 'The speaker proposes accepting a delay rather than using unchecked figures. No schedule change has been agreed.' DE: 'Die Person schlägt vor, lieber eine Verzögerung hinzunehmen als ungeprüfte Zahlen zu verwenden. Eine Terminänderung ist noch nicht vereinbart.'

findings.location: 전이 자료 EN 'pairs an empty box with'; DE 'leere Kiste'
findings.problem: Korean specifies a photograph of an empty box beside the title. English and German make the exhibit an empty box, changing the evidence medium and leaving the model's reference to a photo unsupported.
findings.proposal: EN transfer opening: 'A small modern exhibition displays a photograph of an empty box beside the creative title “Who could forget this empty place?” No real loss or person is specified.' DE: 'Eine kleine moderne Ausstellung zeigt das Foto einer leeren Kiste neben dem kreativen Titel „Wer könnte diese leere Stelle vergessen?“ Ein reales Verlustereignis oder eine reale Person ist nicht festgelegt.'

findings.problem: The Korean requires three sentences in modern Korean separating the three functions; translated instructions omit the output count and modern-language paraphrase condition, although all model versions do supply three sentences.
findings.proposal: EN final instruction: 'Paraphrase the prediction, self-question and statement in three sentences in modern Korean.' DE final instruction: 'Gib Vorhersage, Selbstfrage und Aussage in drei Sätzen in heutigem Koreanisch wieder.'
